title: Conversation: How to Connect with Anyone & Make Every Interaction Count
description: AN INSTANT NEW YORK TIMES BESTSELLER! The powerful proven blueprint for confident conversations and meaningful connection, from New York Times bestselling author of Cues and Captivate Does the thought of small talk with strangers make you want to hide under the couch? Do you crave close friendships but find yourself overanalyzing every social interaction afterward? Do you want to be seen as confident, capable, and genuinely likable — without feeling fake or forced? Are you tired of communication advice that makes you feel manipulative, rehearsed, or inauthentic? If you feel like you were never taught the unspoken rules for how to interact with others, look no further. In Conversation , popular behavior researcher and New York Times bestselling people skills author Vanessa Van Edwards delivers a practical, science-backed playbook for transforming how you show up in any situation. Grounded in decades of research and written in clear, engaging language, Conversation gives you a powerful framework for mastering small talk, building instant rapport, and being the most memorable person in the room (in a good way!) You’ll discover how to: Break the ice without being awkward Stop overthinking what to say next and tune in to your conversation partner Pose the 9 power questions that will level up any relationship Change the subject or end a conversation without damaging the relationship Decode people’s personality patterns so you’re never guessing how to respond Be authentically assertive so you come across as both credible and likable without sacrificing what makes you, you If you’re ready to feel grounded instead of anxious, speak with authority without sounding rehearsed, and build relationships that elevate both your career and your personal life — this book will show you how

title: THE ART OF CONVERSATION: How to Connect with Anyone, Communicate with Confidence, and Make
description: THE ART OF CONVERSATION How to Connect with Anyone, Communicate with Confidence, and Make Every Interaction Count Every conversation is an opportunity to connect, understand, influence, learn, and be understood. Yet for many people, starting a conversation is easy while keeping it natural, meaningful, and engaging can feel surprisingly difficult. The Art of Conversation is a practical guide to becoming a more confident, thoughtful, and effective communicator in everyday life. Whether you are meeting someone for the first time, participating in a professional discussion, making small talk, strengthening a relationship, or navigating an uncomfortable conversation, this book explores the principles that can help you communicate with greater ease and authenticity. Inside, you will discover how to move beyond awkward exchanges and create conversations that feel natural and engaging. You will learn how to listen more attentively, ask better questions, express yourself clearly, recognize nonverbal signals, keep conversations flowing, and adapt your communication style to different personalities and situations. The book also explores the moments when conversation becomes challenging. Rather than avoiding disagreement or uncomfortable subjects, you will learn practical ways to remain calm, communicate respectfully, and keep difficult discussions productive. Most importantly, The Art of Conversation is not about memorizing clever phrases or pretending to be someone you are not. It is about developing the awareness, confidence, curiosity, empathy, and listening skills that make genuine communication possible. title: The Fiancee Farce: A Novel
description: Lambda Literary award winner and national bestselling author Alexandria Bellefleur returns with a steamy sapphic rom-com about a quiet bookseller and a romance novel cover model who agree to a modern-day marriage of convenience... Tansy Adams’ greatest love is her family’s bookstore, passed down from her late father. But when it comes to actual romance… Tansy can’t get past the first chapter. Tired of her stepfamily’s questions about her love life, Tansy invents Gemma, a fake girlfriend inspired by the stunning cover model on a bestselling book. They’ll never actually meet, so what’s the harm in a little fib? Yet when real-life Gemma crosses Tansy’s path, her white lie nearly implodes. Gemma van Dalen is a wild child, the outcast of her wealthy family, and now the latest heir to Van Dalen Publishing. But the title comes with one tiny condition: she must be married in order to inherit. When Gemma discovers a beautiful stranger has been pretending to date her for months, she decides to take the charade one step further—and announces their engagement. Gemma needs a wife to meet the terms of her grandfather’s will and Tansy needs money to save her struggling bookstore. A marriage could be mutually beneficial, if they can fool everyone into thinking it’s a love match. Unexpected sparks fly as Tansy and Gemma play the role of affectionate fiancées, and suddenly the line between convenient arrangement and real feelings begins to blur.
